notes: the dash remark «قال ليس أبو عبيدة ذكره ولكن عبد الرحمن بن الأسود» names another transmitter at the same place: a variant group, never a route (rule 4); the main route keeps «الأسود»
«- ... -» is an editor's remark, so it is kept out of the main route
«أتى الخلاء» is the saying; Ibn Mas'ud is the last link
